# Third-party integration

`Maia3/LICENSE` preserves the pinned upstream AGPL notice for the adapted
encoding/vocabulary and separately provisioned checkpoint/export.
`ONNXRuntime/LICENSE` preserves the MIT notice for the official runtime package.
ChessCore remains a local sibling dependency with its own LICENSE and NOTICE.md.
See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) and
[Provenance](../Docs/Provenance.md) for exact identities and responsibilities.
No nested Git repositories, model weights or runtime binaries are vendored here.
